name: Sakura Succubus 10
source:
Hifumi is determined to marry Hiroki, and to walk down the aisle wearing a beautiful wedding dress, as she has in so many movies. Marying Hiroki is Hifumi’s dream, but it’s a dream the other succubi in Hiroki’s ever-expanding harem can’t approve of.

Hiroki has several other girlfriends, including the ruler of the succubus realm, Yue.

As the first succubus Hiroki ever met, and Hiroki’s former high school sweetheart, Yue has some strong opinions about Hiroki and Hifumi’s union.

How can Hiroki and Hifumi even dream of marrying without telling Yue about their plan? The whole succubus realm is soon thrown into chaos, and Hiroki finds himself in the middle of all of it.

How is he going to get out of this one?!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699940/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一富美决心嫁给广树，并像她在许多电影中那样穿着漂亮的婚纱走上红毯。与弘树结婚是日富美的梦想，但这是弘树不断扩大的后宫中的其他魅魔无法认可的梦想。

弘树还有其他几个女朋友，其中包括魅魔王国的统治者月。

作为弘树遇到的第一个魅魔，以及弘树以前的高中恋人，月对弘树和日富美的结合有一些强烈的看法。

弘树和一富美怎么能梦想着结婚而不告诉月他们的计划呢？整个魅魔领域很快陷入混乱，弘树发现自己正处于这一切之中。

他要怎样才能摆脱这个困境？！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699940/]Steam[/url]]
